We are looking for an experienced Backend Software Engineer to join our growing engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining robust server-side logic and scalable database architectures that power our core applications. We value clean, maintainable code, comprehensive testing, and proactive performance optimization. You will participate in code reviews, mentor junior engineers, and help shape our technical roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

  • Optimize database schemas and queries for performance and reliability.

  • Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, excellent communication skills, and a collaborative mindset.
  • Certifications: Relevant cloud or software certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Developer, Oracle Certified Professional) are a plus.
